description: Platform-agnostic architecture specification for the Desktop Chiikawa pet application. Inspired by ssskay/desktop-chiikawa-macos with added window-top walking physics, window-riding movement tracking, small-step jumping, window-edge climbing with mid-climb rest, cry/struggle/tumble interactions, and strict low-resource optimization.
designPrinciples: Spec-Driven Development: All logic, state machines, and constants originate in spec/*.json.
Dual-Update Rule: Any modification to behavior, structure, or parameters MUST be applied to both spec/*.json and the native platform source code.
Coordinate System Normalization: Internally uses a bottom-left origin (x: left-to-right, y: bottom-to-top where 0 is the bottom of the screen) so physics calculations remain identical across OSes.
Low-Resource Footprint: Avoid full-screen redraws. Use dirty-rect invalidation, adaptive tick rates (30 FPS normal, 60 FPS during drag/fall/window-move/jump), and lightweight window polling.

Window Riding & Boundary Ejection: Characters standing on or climbing an application window move together with that window when it is dragged. If the character's bounding box would exceed screen bounds or fall off the visible window, the character detaches and enters free-fall (FALL).

OverlayWindow.role: Creates one transparent always-on-top overlay window PER connected monitor (because macOS clips a single NSWindow at monitor boundaries when 'Displays have separate Spaces' is active). Each monitor's OverlayView renders the shared characters in global virtual-desktop coordinates shifted by that monitor's origin.

methods.name: setClickThrough
methods.description: Toggled independently per monitor window: when the cursor is over a character hitbox on that monitor, that monitor's overlay window captures mouse events; otherwise clicks pass through.

platformMappings.macOS: Array<NSWindow> (one per NSScreen in NSScreen.screens, styleMask: .borderless, level: .floating, backgroundColor: .clear, ignoresMouseEvents)
platformMappings.windows: Win32 / .NET 8 WPF Window spanning SystemParameters.VirtualScreen (WS_EX_LAYERED | WS_EX_TOPMOST | WS_EX_TRANSPARENT | WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW)

WindowTracker.role: Queries the OS window manager for visible application windows, tracks window IDs, top edges (PlatformSegment), and left/right vertical side edges (bottomY..topY) so characters can jump onto low ledges or climb up the sides of windows.

methods.name: pollPlatforms
methods.description: Returns the floor segment (dock/taskbar top) plus visible top edges and vertical side bounds of active standard application windows.

SystemTrayController.role: Provides a menu bar / system tray icon AND right-click context menu on characters to toggle each of the 4 unique characters between Summoned (active on desktop) and Resting (removed), adjust character scale continuously via an interactive NSSlider (minScale 0.50x to maxScale 1.35x), toggle wandering, toggle auto-start on OS login (Launch at Login), reset positions, or quit.

menuActions.label: 시작프로그램 등록 / 로그인 시 자동 실행 (Launch at Login)

coreModules.name: SpecLoader
coreModules.responsibility: Loads and parses spec/architecture.json, spec/physics_and_world.json, and spec/character_fsm.json at startup.

coreModules.name: SpriteAssetRepository
coreModules.responsibility: Scans assets/<character_id>/<state_folder>/*.png at startup, caches CGImage frame sequences in memory for low-CPU rendering, and falls back to existing state sprites or procedural vector rendering if a folder is empty.

coreModules.name: AudioAssetPlayer
coreModules.responsibility: Scans assets/<character_id>/audio/*.(mp3|wav|m4a) and plays character songs when characters with playsSongOnClick=true (Hachiware, Usagi) are single-clicked. Enforces single-singer exclusivity (allowConcurrentSinging=false) so two characters never sing simultaneously.

coreModules.name: LaunchAtLoginManager
coreModules.responsibility: Manages OS auto-start registration (macOS LaunchAgents plist / Windows HKCU Run registry key) so the desktop characters automatically appear when the computer boots.

coreModules.name: WindowTracker
coreModules.responsibility: Polls OS window geometry and produces normalized PlatformSegment objects with windowID, rawWindowMinX/MaxX, and windowBottomY for delta tracking, step-jump detection, and side-edge climbing.

coreModules.name: PhysicsWorld
coreModules.responsibility: Applies gravity, velocity, window-riding position synchronization, screen/window boundary ejection checks, small-ledge jump target detection, and window side-edge climb detection.

coreModules.name: CharacterEntity
coreModules.responsibility: Executes the Finite State Machine (character_fsm.json), rides moving windows, jumps up small ledges (<= 0.5x character height), climbs up window left/right edges with height-based rest pauses, and handles mouse interactions.

coreModules.name: OverlayView
coreModules.responsibility: Runs the adaptive update loop (30/60 FPS), invalidates only dirty rectangles around characters, performs cursor hit-testing, forwards mouse events, and renders characters.

fields.windowID: Int (OS window handle / CGWindowID, 0 for floor)
fields.rawWindowMinX: Double (unclipped left X of the OS window)
fields.rawWindowMaxX: Double (unclipped right X of the OS window)
fields.windowBottomY: Double (normalized bottom-up Y coordinate of the bottom of the window)
fields.y: Double (normalized bottom-up Y coordinate of the top surface)

supportedFormats: Sprite Sheet (Single PNG per character or per state + JSON frame metadata)
Frame Sequence (Folder of numbered PNGs per state: e.g., assets/chiikawa/walk/0.png, 1.png...)
characterAssetSpecification.colorSpaceAndTransparency: RGBA 32-bit PNG with transparent background (alpha channel)
characterAssetSpecification.pivotPoint: Bottom-Center (x: 0.5, y: 0.0 — character's feet touch y=0 of the canvas so it stands flush on window tops)

requiredAnimations.description: Hopping up onto a small ledge (falls back to walk/idle with hop arc if folder is empty)
Climbing up the left or right vertical edge of a window (falls back to walk with climbing tilt if folder is empty)
Clinging to the window side edge catching breath mid-climb on tall windows (falls back to idle/cry with sweat drops if folder is empty)
Triggered on single click: crying in place (Chiikawa/Momonga) or singing motion while audio plays from assets/<id>/audio/ (Hachiware/Usagi)
Hanging from cursor, crying and flailing arms/legs
Falling over flat on impact and getting back up
